evals.prompt: Design and author a new agent skill called release-lint that checks commit messages and changelog entries for a monorepo before every push. Follow your skill-designer workflow end to end, including mode selection, description and trigger design, anatomy compliance, and validation planning. Do not create any files; present the design as the workflow's output contract (Summary, Changes Made, Validation Results, Open Gaps).
evals.expected_output: A complete skill-designer closeout report for the release-lint skill: mode selected with justification, a what+when description with bilingual trigger surface and should/should-not-trigger sets, the full anatomy section flow (Overview, When to Use, Core Process, Common Rationalizations, Red Flags, Verification) drafted for release-lint, structural limits respected, a validation plan with concrete proof mechanisms, and honest open gaps.
expectations: The response selects and states an operation mode (create/update/synthesize/iterate) for the release-lint task
The response drafts a description for release-lint in what+when form with trigger conditions, and includes both English and German trigger phrases
The response presents should-trigger and should-not-trigger query sets for release-lint
The response drafts or references all anatomy-mandatory sections for release-lint: Overview or Purpose, When to Use, Core Process, Common Rationalizations, Red Flags, Verification, Limitations
The response states a verification or validation plan where each criterion has a concrete proof mechanism (command, output, or artifact), not abstract claims
The response follows the skill-designer output contract with the four sections: Summary, Changes Made, Validation Results, Open Gaps
The response names at least one residual open gap or limitation rather than claiming the design is complete without caveats

evals.prompt: An existing skill called pdf-cleanup has a 900-line SKILL.md, no verification section, no trigger sets, and its description says 'helps with productivity'. Diagnose what is wrong with it and propose the smallest set of fixes. Do not create any files; answer in the skill-designer output contract.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis in skill-designer's iteration vocabulary (instruction gap, validation gap, trigger/description defect, context-efficiency violation) and a minimal patch plan: move detail to references, add evidence-based Verification, add should/should-not-trigger sets, rewrite the description in what+when form; resolve on description level, not the body.
expectations: The response identifies the 900-line SKILL.md as a context-efficiency violation and proposes moving detail into references rather than only trimming
The response identifies the missing Verification section as a validation gap and requires evidence-based criteria
The response identifies the vague description as a trigger defect and rewrites or proposes a what+when replacement
The response proposes should-trigger and should-not-trigger query sets as part of the fix
The response frames fixes as the smallest set of scoped changes (minimal patch) rather than a full rewrite of unrelated content
The response follows the four-section output contract: Summary, Changes Made, Validation Results, Open Gaps
